CHAP. XX. 
 
  Rabbah is taken, ver. 1-3.   The Philistine giants are slain, ver. 4-8.
V. 2. To weigh a talent-Or, to be worth a talent, that is, five thousand four hundred and seventy five pounds.
V. 8. They fell, &c -We need not fear great men against us, while we have the great God for us.
